controls.title: Access control
controls.summary: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and assets should be established based on business and security requirements. In cloud terms, IAM policies must grant only the access each identity needs. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ; ISO text is copyrighted and not reproduced.)
references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A control A.5.15 — consult the licensed standard for normative text

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.summary: Allocation and management of authentication information such as passwords and keys should be controlled, including secure issuance and rotation. Long-lived, unrotated cloud access keys are a common violation. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A control A.5.17 — consult the licensed standard for normative text

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.summary: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management, should be defined and implemented to protect confidentiality and integrity. Unencrypted storage buckets or databases violate this control. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A control A.8.24 — consult the licensed standard for normative text

controls.title: Networks security
controls.summary: Networks and network devices should be secured, managed, and controlled to protect information in systems and applications. Overly open security groups exposing services to the internet violate this control. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A control A.8.20 — consult the licensed standard for normative text

controls.title: Logging
controls.summary: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and security events should be produced, stored, protected, and analysed. Cloud audit logging and access logging must be enabled to support detection and investigation. (Summary authored by ComplianceIQ.)
references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022, Annex A control A.8.15 — consult the licensed standard for normative text
